newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SPS Technologies started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SPS Technologies started with buy.

text.p: -- The Chicago Corp on Monday initiated coverage of SPS Technologies Inc with a buy recommendation.
-- Analyst Robert McCarthy said he started coverage with a 12-month price target of $82.
-- He said annual earnings-per-share growth was expected to average 20 percent 1995-2000.

-- "Rising commercial aircraft production, market share gains, additional additive acquisitions (not in our estimates), and improving operating efficiencies (are) expected to drive strong, visible earnings growth," McCarthy wrote.

-- "We see recent strong earnings growth as the tip of an iceberg," he added, noting his earnings per share estimate of $3.60 for 1996 was up 44 percent from $2.50 in 1995. "Our analysis indicates that EPS can climb to $4.60 in 1997 and further to $5.60 in 1998, without any contribution from further acquisition activity."
-- SPS Technologies is a $500 million supplier of high-strength precision fasteners and engineered materials to aerospace, automotive and other industrial markets.
-- Its shares traded up 1 at 63-3/4. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
